title: WeatherNext 3: a global AI model for weather forecasting
summary: A model that learns from real-time geostationary satellite data and produces hourly forecasts, at resolutions down to 5 km for temperature and humidity (about five times finer than WeatherNext 2). For short-term precipitation, Google reports improvements of up to 60% over NASA's IMERG. These are ‘up to’ figures from Google's evaluations, with an independent ranking by Brightband.

evidence.tested: Precipitation forecasts were scored with CRPS against baselines: gains of up to 60% over IMERG, 30% over MRMS and 10% over rain gauges for early lead times; independent live evaluations by Brightband ranked the model.
evidence.unknown: The 'up to' figures lack full test setup, longer-range gains are largest where forecasts are weak, and the atmosphere retains unpredictability.
evidence.ai_role: The model ingests live geostationary satellite data and historical analyses, trains on station observations and produces gridded fields, cyclone tracks and station-level forecasts.
